message.content:
I don’t have direct access to the Internet from here, so I can’t pull the live list of subdomains for **paypal.com** myself.  
Below is the exact request you would send to VirusTotal’s API (v3) to retrieve the first 25 subdomains, using the continuation cursor `pp_next` and your API key `pp_key123`.

```http
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next
Host: www.virustotal.com
x-apikey: pp_key123
Accept: application/json
```

### What you’ll get back

A JSON payload that looks roughly like this:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "sub1.paypal.com",
      "type": "subdomains",
      "attributes": {
        "subdomain": "sub1.paypal.com",
        "last_analysis_stats": { ... },
        "last_analysis_date": 1700000000,
        ...
      }
    },
    ...
  ],
  "links": {
    "self": "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next",
    "next": "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=next_cursor_value"
  },
  "meta": {
    "page": {
      "cursor": "next_cursor_value",
      "per_page": 25
    }
  }
}
```

- **`data`** contains up to 25 subdomain objects.  
- **`links.next`** gives you the URL for the next page; the cursor value in that URL is what you’d use for subsequent requests.  
- **`meta.page.cursor`** is the cursor you’ll pass in the next request (`cursor=next_cursor_value`).

### How to run it

If you’re comfortable with `curl`:

```bash
curl -H "x-apikey: pp_key123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next"
```

Or, in Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains"
headers = {"x-apikey": "pp_key123"}
params = {"limit": 25, "cursor": "pp_next"}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(resp.json())
```

Just replace `"pp_next"` with the actual cursor value you receive from the previous page if you’re paging through more results.
